text: 7月17日，东方财富证券研究所副所长、首席策略官陈果点评今日市场行情称：“我们对A股今年走势一直是N型判断。我们认为正在迎来今年的黄金买点，市场主要指数有望在下半年创出新高。”
text_en: On July 17, Chen Guo, Deputy Director of the Research Institute and Chief Strategy Officer at East Money Securities, commented on the day's market trends: 'Our forecast for A-share performance this year has always been an N-shaped trajectory. We believe the golden buying opportunity for this year is arriving, and major market indices are expected to hit new highs in the second half of the year.'
